headline: OKX Shed 976.1 Million Dollars In 24 Hours
narrative: OKX clean assets fell 976.1 million dollars over 24 hours. The figure is the change in dollars held on the venue excluding the exchange's own token, so the drop means that money left OKX. Tracked exchanges together posted a 997.8 million dollar net outflow, while Bitfinex took in 319.4 million.
author: jordan
